## Description

Describe what changed and why the change is necessary.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance or tooling
- [ ] CI/CD

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Existing tests pass, when applicable
- [ ] The interface was reviewed on mobile, when applicable
- [ ] Accessibility was considered
- [ ] No secrets or confidential data were added

## GitFlow

- [ ] The pull request targets the correct branch
- [ ] The branch follows the repository naming convention
- [ ] The changes are focused on one objective
- [ ] The commits follow Conventional Commits

## Screenshots

Add screenshots or recordings when the change affects the interface.

## Limitations or pending decisions

Describe known limitations, follow-up work or architectural decisions that still
need to be made.
